title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in fifu.app…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the fifu.app plugin Featured Image from URL, affecting versions up to 6.1.8. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
